# Third-party components

Third-party repositories and model weights are not vendored here. Install or fetch official versions separately and preserve their revision and license metadata.

Relevant components include AnyMatch, Ditto, Jina reranker, Hugging Face Transformers, Sentence Transformers, WDC Products, DeepMatcher benchmark datasets, and Link-Lives Release 2. This repository does not alter or relicense those works.
